Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.wms

Class WmsLayerManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.wms.WmsLayerManager
public class WmsLayerManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer Cascading WMS Layer REST API client.

Verified against: GeoServer 2.28.2 / 2026-04-02 (Kartoza Docker kartoza/geoserver)

Source: gs-rest/src/main/java/org/geoserver/rest/catalog/WMSLayerController.java
@RequestMapping(path = RestBaseController.ROOT_PATH)
GeoServer REST base path: /geoserver/rest

Endpoints

 GET  /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmsstores/{store}/wmslayers
 GET  /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmslayers
 POST /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmsstores/{store}/wmslayers
 POST /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmslayers
 GET  /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmsstores/{store}/wmslayers/{layer}
 GET  /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmslayers/{layer}
 PUT  /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmsstores/{store}/wmslayers/{layer}
 DELETE /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmsstores/{store}/wmslayers/{layer}
 DELETE /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmslayers/{layer}

POST /workspaces/{ws}/wmslayers (no store in the URL) requires the target store to be named explicitly in the request body — see publishByWorkspace(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.wmslayer.PublishWmsLayerRequest). Verified against GeoServer 2.28.2.

    • listAvailable

      public List<String> listAvailable(String workspaceName, String storeName)
      Lists layer names available from the remote WMS server that have not yet been published.

      Issues a real GetCapabilities HTTP request to the remote WMS. If the capabilitiesURL is unreachable, GeoServer returns 500.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMS store name (required)
      Returns:
      list of remote WMS layer names not yet published (empty list if none)

    • publish

      public WmsLayer publish(String workspaceName, String storeName, PublishWmsLayerRequest request)
      Publishes a remote WMS layer from a WMS store.

      On publish, GeoServer calls CatalogBuilder.initWMSLayer() automatically to set bbox and CRS. A GeoServer LayerInfo is also created automatically.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMS store name (required)
      request - publish parameters (name + nativeName required)
      Returns:
      the published WMS layer details
      Throws:
      ResourceAlreadyExistsException - if a WMS layer with the same name already exists

    • publishByWorkspace

      public WmsLayer publishByWorkspace(String workspaceName, String storeName, PublishWmsLayerRequest request)
      Publishes a remote WMS layer without a store segment in the URL. The target store must be named explicitly in the request body (via storeName), since GeoServer does not auto-resolve it the way it does for FeatureTypes. Verified against GeoServer 2.28.2.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMS store the new layer belongs to (required)
      request - publish parameters (name + nativeName required)
      Returns:
      the published WMS layer details
      Throws:
      ResourceAlreadyExistsException - if a WMS layer with the same name already exists

    • update

      @Deprecated public WmsLayer update(String workspaceName, String storeName, String layerName, UpdateWmsLayerRequest request)
      Deprecated.
      always throws on GeoServer 2.28.2 (server-side XStream persister bug, not a client defect — see class Javadoc and docs/GEOSERVER_BUG_WMS_LAYER_PUT.md). Kept for API completeness and to document the failure via WmsLayerManagerIntegrationTest#update_alwaysThrows500(); do not call this in new code expecting it to succeed. No workaround exists client-side.
      Updates a WMS layer.

      GeoServer 2.28.2 BUG: PUT always returns 500. Every PUT call to GeoServer 2.28.2 returns 500 due to an internal bug. Calling this method will throw GeoServerResponseException(500).

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMS store name (required)
      layerName - name of the WMS layer to update (required)
      request - update parameters (required; specify at least one field)
      Returns:
      the updated WMS layer (unreachable due to GeoServer bug)
      Throws:
      WmsLayerNotFoundException - if the layer does not exist
      GeoServerResponseException - always thrown with 500 on GeoServer 2.28.2

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName, String layerName)
      Deletes a WMS layer. Uses recurse=false.

      Returns 403 Forbidden if a GeoServer LayerInfo still references the WMS layer (AuthenticationException). Layers published via POST always have an associated LayerInfo, so use delete(ws, store, layer, true) or delete the LayerInfo separately first.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMS store name (required)
      layerName - WMS layer name to delete (required)
      Throws:
      WmsLayerNotFoundException - if the layer does not exist (404)
      AuthenticationException - if a LayerInfo reference exists (403)

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName, String layerName, boolean recurse)
      Deletes a WMS layer.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMS store name (required)
      layerName - WMS layer name to delete (required)
      recurse - when true, cascade-deletes associated LayerInfo; when false, returns 403 if a LayerInfo reference exists
      Throws:
      WmsLayerNotFoundException - if the layer does not exist (404)
      AuthenticationException - when recurse=false and a LayerInfo reference exists (403)
